_comment: Lab 4 dashboard definition for GCP. Vertex AI built-in metrics provide request rate, error rate, and latency without adding network calls to the prediction service. PSI is emitted as a custom Cloud Monitoring metric. Model version is available from the structured service logs.
title: ITCS355 — Prediction service

panels.title: Request rate
panels._note: Vertex AI records prediction responses automatically, so monitoring does not add latency to /predict.

panels.title: Error rate by class
panels._note: 4xx and 5xx are shown separately because 4xx usually indicates a caller/request problem while 5xx indicates a serving-side failure.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels._note: The service SLO requires p95 latency below 500 ms. p99 is also monitored to reveal tail-latency problems.

panels.title: Feature drift — temp_c PSI
panels._note: PSI is calculated by monitoring/drift.py over the current input window against the training reference data and emitted through adapter.emit_metric.

panels.title: Model version in production
panels._note: The FastAPI service writes model_version in every structured request log. The dashboard should display the most recent production version.
